name: Maneuver Amplifier - Retaliation
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Retaliation capability.

61229.name: Improved Movement I · Retaliation
61229.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When Retaliating, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
